### Etymology
#### Glyph
From the native "1-4-7" numerical system.
#### Sound
- Japanese "go"
- Numbers always end in a nasal coda ("n")
- [[Sen'fi/Glossary/Nature/gon\|Sen'fi/Glossary/Nature/gon]] is already taken, so a "y" was added.
